text: GAME OVER... Great game if you have never played it. but the rewards are extremely annoying you have click it 5/10 just for one reward and you have to do this 100+ times. I stopped collecting rewards. now they aren't adding any more levels. so once you get to the max level it's time for a new game. thanks for the experience. also I have never had any ads so unsure about other reviews. but I've had this game for a long time. it was always my go to every time they released new levels.

I don't know what people are saying about this game supposedly being "pay to win". I've been playing this game for a long time and haven't spent a single dollar on anything. In my opinion this is in the top three best mobile games I have ever played. A good combo if your new, use the mini pekka and the giant as a starting move, but always spawn the giant first so the attention is on it. Then release the mini pekka and and your all set for a first attack.

Do not install this game if you've never played it before. It is broken and a shadow of it's former self. 2026 update, they have added way more pay to win options to the game. The amount of options available will cost lots of money but let you max out cards, evolutions, and heroes. Also, due to the increasing number of options, there is no way to properly balance everything. You will lose repeatedly to different cards that you can't counter no matter the composition of your deck.

As a long time user (since 2017) and casual player I'd seriously appreciate it if past unlocked chest, such as those from game pass, be easily unlockable in bunch by just a button instead of going thru each one and opening them. It just takes too much time specially when you have 40+ chests from past game passes and having to go thru each one. I've lost hundreds of chests just because I play at most 15 - 20 mins a day and it's very tedious and takes away from actually playing

The game has been in a pretty terrible state for a while, but recently the developers put together an event to address the state of the game, where players could tell them if they were satisfied. they then said nothing would be changing, and only provided players the option to say they were satisfied, patting themselves on the back. So I'm voting in the only place that actually matters. I'm not satisfied with the state of the game, progression is far too slow and far too pay to win.

This game is Pay to Win. The worst part about that fact is that the gameplay is great (for mobile), which makes it even more frustrating. If you spend no money or little money, you can do great in the game's main mode (trophy run) for a while, but as you move up, you eventually become fodder for those who pay continuously, so they can feel their ego inflate and their purchases feel worthwhile, so the cycle of greed can continue. Don't fall for the trap, pay or not; you lose, SuperCell wins.

The constant horrible matchups and pay to win situation makes this game more stressful than fun for me. I've played this game for a long time now and it has not been as fun as it used to be for a while thanks to the gold pass, evolutions, champions, heroes, and the same group cards being used by everyone, making every game feel stale and end the same.

Trash matching algorithm, P2W system. If you enjoy having a plethora of cards at your disposal but only ever see 2-3 decks being used because Supercell can't seem to figure out how to balance anything, then this is the game for you. The new Hero's are a waste of time and money now so don't bother grabbing those either (that's why they made some hero's free through events, they aren't worth anything). Been playing 10 years on and off, unsure if the game is salvageable or not.

The gameplay is just ok. The game seems to put you up against everyone who's just a little better than you. If you pay money, you can own special characters' abilities. One character (mega knight) is used by 90% of the players. It's ruined the entire game. all the good modes to play rely on being in a clan and hopefully one of those 2 people want to play against you. its like a fun game but they keep taking the fun out of it.

The most pay-to-win game of all time. Originally this game had a level gap which could be bridged by playing the game for thousands of hours. Now, you can reach max card level but you can never get every evolution or hero without paying. originally paying would save you time. now, paying is an automatic win to matches. Do not download this game.

I downloaded this game after 2 or 3 years of not playing and it hasn't changed. The game is extremely P2W with heroes and powered up cards. The match making is somehow still trophy based despite card stats and now castle level determining a vast majority of gameplay. I'm extremely disappointed in how little innovation has happened. I wish I could give this game 0 stars.

I didn't touch this game for several years after my initial review so felt I'd try it while on a longer trip. The variety and availability of decks has definitely improved a bit but still really isn't great for casual players and ones who don't want to spend any money. While I can find it fun at times the overall flow, especially with the hero type cards, feels poorly established for a returning player. Maybe it's better for those who started in it or have been on for the whole ride.

Game is fine, but they messed everything basic up. Card acquisition seems to be much slower, as well as overall progression, and the Hero card paywall B.S, just a money hungry game and I don't see why. Emotes should not be no $5, and if you introduce a battlepass system, then you need to incorporate a way where players can PLAY to pay, instead of asking for $12 dollars EVERY single season. Just greedy, and the amount you spend on ANYTHING in this game is just not worth it. Save your money.

I've been playing this game for 10 years, I have multiple accounts and the only way to contact them for in game support is in the game and there is no way to reach them or atleast a real person through the support page when you go to their website, someone replies with you have to contact is through the game they dont care about you or your profile just how many micro purchases they can get, then delete your profile so you can redo all those purchases more like supersuck rather than supercell

it's fun for the most part You get to pick different cards to try to make the best deck. it is very annoying though when you are battling someone and they drop the same card within two to three times of each other and you lose the first minute of the game. it also doesn't make sense that you could win by two towers and only get 29 crowns but then if you lose it's automatically negative 30 or 31 crowns.

Amazingly fun or so I thought the newer seasons have introduced the evolutions and champions. Since then its been the same repetitive plays of wizard/witch evolutions with barely and solid counters. Not only that but the off with his crown even has been absolute garbage. This recent roll (4th) gave a few gems and not even the option to be unsatisfied only giving 2 yes options as if it weren't a choice. What's the point of flaunting the jackpots and its high amounts left if NO ONE GETS THEM!!

It seems that there are players on this app that are allowed to have more privileges than others... (hackers). Its not fun when you work hard to get a higher level, to then face someone that has unlimited cards as they need. You report players and are discouraged or shamed for doing so, when its clear when someone is doing something shady. Do better, Clash...

This game used to be one of the best mobile games in my experience! Lot's changed since "my time" 5-10yrs ago. Seemingly for the worse, but it's still upper tier. The ads sometimes get to be a lot, but WAY better when compared to most other "games:" manipulative apps disguised as fun or easy income. The most "intrusive" thing is the bright colors hijacking my brain because I'm no longer used to that level of simulation (by choice).

After years of playing, I still somewhat like the game, but unfortunately, they are so much focused on making money that the game has entered on a cycle of getting the latest card to win before releasing a much better one. so on and so forth. Whenever you get 5 stars chests from playing, they always will give you a duplicated maxed card when you still have tons of other cards to improve, and the compensation are useless shards. Don't get this if you are not planning to spend a whole lot of money

Great Game, highly recommend, dont need money to play and progression is super slow, plus they are constantly put new things into the game and doing balance changes. Okay Supercell... when I pay 11.99 for the pass halfway through the month, make it satisfying to actually collect your rewards, I spent over an hour having scroll to each one my rewards instead of just being able to collect them one after the other..... Fix this!!!!

I love this game but theres a huge issue with network connectivity, anytime im in a match and the opponent just so happens to be losing,I start to get internet connection issues but my wifi isnt the issue I've already checked. If your game can allow players to somehow "turn the odds in their favor" then it isnt a game I want to play. Several times its happened now but again, its your guys' game thats been out years maybe you guys know more than me im just a stupid consumer.

Can be very frustrating when people just pay their way though the game and than get most of that payed stuff that was really good turned into somthing not good. Not only that but the whole game is based on a pay to win mechanics. The match making is by far the worst part about the game! It ruined itself over the years. Over all it is a strategy game that you have to be very precise when playing. If you rage easily don't download.

Your mystery box drop rates are completely unacceptable. Why is gold even an option? Before introducing these, frankly deceptive, boxes, I would've been able to upgrade cards to level 14 completely through consistency. Now I play every day but get next to nothing in terms of cards, and especially Wild Cards. Which, by the way, are phenomenally rare. Not just large amounts of Wild Cards, ANY wild cards at all. More often than not, a 3 star box will give GOLD. I have a million. I do not need more.

This game made me want to punt a fish across a basketball court. I just experienced the worst connection of my life. I WAS NEXT TO MY INTERNET MOTEM!! I was up by one tower, and all I had to do to seal the game was arrows his tower. When I went to do so, the game told me I had poor connection. It froze. my towers were basically full health, he was already missing one and the other one had 98 health. I went to play arrows, and the freeze happened. the game went 10x speed to catch up and I lost.

I love the game and the ideas behind it, but between connection loss and the amount of money for items is insane, there should be a way to earn the pass like a certain amount of playing time or something that doesn't ask for 12 bucks every season! The connection loss isn't too bad, but sometimes it would make me lose games because I would have to fully reload into the game, which in the arena I am in, all my towers would be gone.

even though the app has a "play again" button that shows up when a match is over, it still forces you to sit through each chest opening one by one which takes ages, making me not want to play in the short amount of time I do have to play. It would be very nice if there was an "open all chests" button so I didn't have to waste so much time just sitting there tapping my screen.

I've been playing this game pretty regular for the past 7 years and love it. But also hate it with a passion. the standard mode can be frustrating but imo seems pretty fair. The hero cards and whatnot aren't overpowered to the point you can't mount an effective strategy against. It's the merge tactics mode that is infuriating. extremely pay to win. Some troops are so overpowered unless you get perfect troop rolls they wipe the board in a matter of seconds with zero defense. FIX IT!!!!

Unfair match ups and Supercell still allow hackers to control the game. Some how they are able to shut off your connection to the game while battling and then you end up losing the match every time. This game has become an extreme pay to play. Everything is behind a pay wall. I miss when you were able to purchase a game and that was it, not spend hundreds of dollars just to gain an advantage in the game Just horrible.

Played this game on and off on different accounts and devices since it came out. It's not the same game that was so good and fun on launch. Excess monetisation, random deletion of useful features, and making all the little pieces outside of actual battle take longer and be more inconvenient is a weird direction for sure. All in all can't be recommended at all anymore. The game isn't the same awesome supercell game they initially promised anymore.

Guys, I totally love this game. But if you enjoy playing it and you're any good, you quickly rise to a rank where you're playing people who just have significantly more leveled up troops than you. This makes it almost impossible to win. Also, some units are so overpowered that you end up facing them every time. When those units are also leveled up, it becomes a grind of playing against people who employ no strategy other than to drop the leveled up heavy units, you can go back. It's frustrating.

Have played for years and have enjoyed it until they introduced the 'hero' cards. Though these new cards do give the game a needed variety, they are very overpowered if not countered by other 'hero' cards. This wouldn't be a problem, if they weren't hidden behind a pay wall. Over the years, I have paid more for this game than a real console game, yet this system essentially required continuous payments to remain competitive. It's great if you like being dominated alot...

9 year badge. This was one of the best games I've ever played, and I still cherish the hours spent back when it was strategy based. Gave it another go after a 2 and a half year break. Like all great card games where cost to play is involved (elixir here), new mechanics or new cards costing less than their value ruining balance, destroying strategy based approach. Started with heroes and their abilities which weren't too awful compared to what it is now. Select units with abilities devalues them.

Let me start by saying I have been playing this game (somewhat on and off) for the last 6-8 years (not quite sure). The game has devolved so poorly into pay-to-win mechanics that you are almost physically unable to progress through the games "ranked" mode (ladder) without purchasing cards from the shop. My average card level is roughly 13, which a few years ago used to be amazing. Now, it's terrible. With the addition to placing max level caps at level 16 (and everything else), ThisGameSucksNow!

Played since launch and have always enjoyed the game which is amazing. Sadly the game is poorly managed. The over monetization is off the scale. 100% pay to win which is very sad. I consistently bought the battle pass and made purchases from the shop for years because I believe in supporting games that bring value. The excessive greed of the game management has driven off a lot of the core players and I won't be spending anything more as a result of this. Hopefully they get it together soon.

This game has always been fun. but at the same time there is numerous problems. I have experienced issues with disconnecting or glitching out. The first problem about this is if you do lag out they still count the trophy loss I see this unfair as most of the time it's not most people's fault. As the game continues on it gets frustrating as the game ignores recommendations from fans and players. Most of the time you will run into pay to wins. I don't recommend this game if you get mad easily.

At first, when I downloaded this game, I loved it, I spent hours on it grinding my way through each game and level. Although, when the game got more popular, it kind of just got into a pay to win hacker game instead of a fun, stragy game. I did a 1 star because it seemed like they weren't improving the game. They were just finding every way to get as much money as they could.

Played this game since it first came out (10 years). I've reached the point where I have to uninstall. I am one of the few people that haven't spent a dime on this money and space grab app. I'm okay with people spending money to win; but, I'm not okay having to remove half the apps from my phone every week. The fact that this game and Clash of Clans takes up over 4GB is ridiculous, especially considering they haven't fixed the game. There are features that don't work or are pointless. Data grab!

This game is WAY TOO HARD to the point where it's not even fun to play. For one thing you hit a point where you just cant get enough cards to level up cards beyond ~LV6, even if you spend real money in the game. For players, the deck has to have 8 cards Yet in the battles, the computer plays the same 3 to 4 cards over & over. Strategy is impossible when you cant guarantee your own deck will give you the same cards being used against you b/c you've got 4 more potential cards than your opponent.

I was really addicted for about 2 years. they added evolutions and the game became beyond frustrating with the pay to win situation. I deleted it shortly after. I came back a year later to play for 6 months with the addition of heroes. the game is even more pay to win now. sometimes the game is fun, but some days the matching system seems to just connect you with hard counters. some days this game is no fun at all.

I'm getting HOUR LONG BANS because my game keeps crashing. I keep looking like a jackass to my teammates because the game takes like 30s to open after a crash, so the match is over and lost by the time I reconnect. Performance has tanked with recent updates. Random lag and huge delay for placing troops/spells. Even something as simple as loading into the MAIN MENU and opening the shop can cause a crash. Supercell, this is UNACCEPTABLE. At least make an ACTUALLY useful settings menu or something.

This game used to be really fun, but with the implementation of the "battle pass" it has become more pay to win than ever. I've played this game since 2017 and slowly watched it go down the drain. At a certain arena, you will basically be cut off from progressing if you don't spend $ as the match making is as unbalanced as it gets. In the new update cards are now lvl 16 when lvl 15 was VERY hard to get The new hero card is also a no win condition to bait for pass purchases. where's my refund 🤔

Every month update .. Every month search for storage on my device to un-install apps to fit this game on my device , This is ANNOYING as Hell .. I don't want to spend money That I really don't have .. to spend to play this game each month with new overpriced and overpowered characters that doesn't really make any sense.... My advice to New players give it a go, but don't get too wrapped up as you progress not unless you have a huge wallet and a good device with at least 1 terabyte of storage.

Very Pay to Win. If you don't spend real money on the game it will take FOREVER to level up cards. Every new update they add new ways to break the balance of the game. Progression to unlock heroes and evolutions takes lots of grinding and pure luck. Those who pay money can get them easily making the gap between p2w and f2p ginormous. The actual concept of the game is unique but due to all these problems it's kinda hard to ignore. Also, the devs don't listen to what the players want at all.

It's an awesome game, with plenty of room for leveling up, playing with friends, and progressing. Card are (mostly) balanced, and it is easy enough to learn. The 1 big problem this game has is that it can be hard to level up as a f2p, especially with all the paying people buying all these special offers and just laying waste to you. So def would recommend playing if you want a casual experience, but you may have to spend 5 dollars here and there if your impatient.

I really want to like this game but it seems that recently the developers have decided to focus more on the "pay to win" aspects than maintaing game balance. The evolutions and heros are fine and they add more complexity to the stratagy of battles, but they should be easier to obtain in a timely manner without spending money. The matchmaking also has some issues that I dont think will ever change. Its becoming more difficult to like this game when playing it feels so frustrating.

Money sucker! The game is fantastic. It's highly addictive once you get the feel of it. One thing which I found annoying is when you are in battle mode and you get matched against an opponent of higher your level. It's very difficult to beat them since the health of their cards is much more. Ergo, I wish if we get matched according to king tower levels in battle instead of number of trophies. That would be a level playing field. also, gameplay sucks on mobile internet. I hope creators fix it.

After almost 7 years of playing and staying positive. The newest update just spells Pay to Win. For the past few years I always enjoyed Party mode over climbing a ladder with an unbalanced algorithm. Party mode was the only way I earn gold coins to level up to 14. You have taken that away to replace with Pay to Win Party mode. The max amount daily is capped at 1000 which is accomplished in a few rounds. You need to pay to collect double amount with a time limit. Who ask for this update?

Would be fun, which it is, if it wasn't horrible at finding wifi. Can't even go five seconds without disconnecting. Once I was in a battle and my enemy was winning and I could've defended it if this sad excuse of a game didn't boot me out. I have full bars on wifi and internet but then I go into the game and then I have like 1 bar or just none. It gets so bad that in fact, it works BETTER outside in the car... FIX YOUR STUPID GAMES, this also happens on CoC too.

As a free to play player with 8+ years I've seen this game change and grow. All the good stuff and the bad. It's a better state now then it was a few years ago. Some things are still not balanced but things have been shaping up recently. The competitive nature of the game feels lacking with no incentive to play ranked. As of recently they changed trophyroad and ranked once more linking the two. Hitting 15000 unlocks ranked and resets at the end of the season to 12000 which is a horrible change.

It's an alright game, but with each update it gets worse. They release Evo's for cards that don't need it like the Mega Knight and Pekka which genuinely takes away from the experience. At first it was just a little annoying but now it's gotten to a point that you can't play casual 2v2 or 1v1 without running into an evo pekka, evo mega knight, with a sparky placed behind it or what have you. I guess it's just a bit annoying to see Supercell encourage a playstyle that makes the game boring

Money sucker! The game is fantastic. It's highly addictive once you get the feel of it. One thing which I found annoying is when you are in battle mode and you get matched against an opponent of higher your level. It's very difficult to beat them since the health of their cards is much more. Ergo, I wish if we get matched according to king tower levels in battle instead of number of trophies. That would be a level playing field. also, gameplay sucks on mobile internet. I hope creators fix it.

For Supercell: You may have heard this but yes, chest opening time needs to be more flexible. There should be a system to encourage more playtime to decrease chest opening time when full. Else, it feels hopeless when you already have 4 chests and playing again does nothing.      To Players: It is a great new concept from CoC but the cards paid players have are far too good. So do keep in mind that if you are not going to pay, however skilled you are, it is almost impossible to trophy push to the top.

This game is no more fun now. But it used to be a lot more fun game back then when there was no evolutions, champions , etcetera. I could have played it like for more than 7-8 games a time , but now I feel bored and exhausted with just one game , probably something to do with unnecessary evolution and hero champion making and whatever that stuff is ...its irritating...

although I am getting 40+ mbps internet speed. The game is buffering, 🛜 symbol is always there. Not able to play even a single battle. I tried everything, that means it's a problem from the CRL app/server. I am so tired of facing this problem after every certain period or they drop an update. Will uninstall the game if this problem will not get fixed.

I enjoyed Merge tactics mode - it was really something new. And it was fun for some weeks, until the last update. Right now, it's completely missing balance - at the moment the battle outcome totally doesn't depend on your skills. It just depends on the "luck". Sometimes (less often) it gives you cards that you need and you're unstoppable whatever opponent does. But more often you don't get proper cards - I use to play Tomb Queen, but often I don't get any undead until i.e. round 3 or 4...

Unfortunately, some drastic changes have been made. What set CR apart from other games is disappearing, and the focus is now more than ever on monetisation. As a player, you have now less power to get the cards you want. The game has been transformed into a shell of its former glory and they are now copying the same games Supercell had sworn to never become.

I feel as if the supercell boardroom for clash royal is half composed of developers dedicated to creating the best game possible, because clearly a lot of work goes into the interfaces, animations and card designs. The other half of the boardroom is composed of former EA employees who are doing everything in their power to make the game as addictive as possible. I swear if they released a $15 premium version without the in-app purchases it might be the greatest game of all time.

P2W game, your opponent always plays higher level cards ( always +2~3 level) and it's so balanced! Also, the clan war match making is even worse. Btw, I have an old account and try to recover it through 'help and support ', I provide many details of the account a few times but the only replies are always the same: ' Thanks for the provided information. We will now assign an agent to review your case and get back to you as soon as possible. ' Life is hard, enjoy the game :)

I've been playing Clash Royale for nearly 9 years. This was one of my favorite games growing up, and for a long time it was the perfect mix of strategy, skill, and progression. What made Clash Royale special was that better decisions and better gameplay usually won matches. Even when I lost, I felt like I could learn and improve. Unfortunately, that feeling has largely disappeared. Over the years, the game has become increasingly focused on monetization rather than competitive balance.

I have been playing the game for over 10 years now and love the game. It has always had the connection issues whilst you are mid-battle. That wifi/connection issue has been the worst in the last few days/weeks. Every second game I play crashes the game with connection issue and ends up killing my interest. And it's definitely not my internet having the problem.

BEWARE !!! Game team is entirely focused on Money. I palyed it for 3 years. There is so much imbalances in game. The one who spends money can easily beat a skilled player due to level advantage. The growth is extremely slow. I literally wasted my 3 years on this game and i am no way near the payers who spend money. The Clash Royale Team is very Greedy. So if someone is playing this game I would advice not to spend any money on it at all. Best advice is to not play this game at all.

One thing that really frustrates me about this game is that battles aren't matched according to player levels. Players seem to be paired randomly, which makes battles unfair. If one player is two levels higher and has cards that are 2–3 levels stronger, the lower-level player hardly stands a chance, no matter how well they play. Lately, almost every second battle has been like this, and it's becoming very frustrating.

The epitome of pay to win gaming. Level 16 was quite possibly the worst decision any gaming company could've made, on par or exceeding even EA. Only at the top level of or certain miscellaneous gamemodes do levels not matter. Even in ranked, there are so many level 15 units that just lose in otherwise 'balanced' interactions. I do not recommend this to anyone new to this game. Please stay as far away as you can for your own mental health.

I'm playing this game for about 6 years. It was very nice in the beginning but now you can only win if you pay. On the latest update, i entered a game, then everything locked, i couldn't add any card on the stage. After in restarted the game, i already lost the ladt chance to win the challenge. Very unprofessional... I'm thinking to uninstall the game.

Edit: July 3, 2026 - Can confirm that the game is still terrible. Game is terrible if you're a free-to-play player. The dev's decision to introduce heroes is egregious and out-of-touch with the general player base. Bugs go unaddressed for years at a time, but hey the store is always working!!

I am old player of the game. I have been playing it for 7 years. But now it has been never this frustrating than ever. Before free to play players (me myself) did not were never this in disadvantage compared to the players who paid but it has become so much disadvantage compared Free to play players and players who pay .It has become a pay to win game. Even after all this I am still a big fan of the game and Is still the game could restore itself by listening to the players and removing some thi

I gave it a 3 star review several years ago because there were some features that were severely lacking in clan management, the overall game was still fun to play. Now I changed it to 1 star because there are simply TOO MANY chests and rewards to claim. it feels like half the time I'm just opening chests, and the worst part 90% of the stuff you get in those rewards is stuff you don't really care about. I have 50+ chests to be claimed. If there was a "Claim All Available Rewards" button it'd be

Best game ever. Always loved it despite various stuff happening all the time, this game has a special place in my heart. I love the game design, gameplay and progression. I understand, it's difficult to make the game balanced, but developers are trying their best to make it better. I want to see new content such as new spells, win conditions and game modes. I look forward to ya'll! Good luck👍

Don't let anybody decieve you, this game is fun for a while but once you hit a certain point, you'll be stuck and have to pay to be able to upgrade all your cards to a higher level, this game is also rigged! they have a system that makes it so your winrate is 50% so you'll be in a loop of winning and losing, no skill can let you win a hard counter, unless you're planning on paying, don't download and save your time, sad that the only 'fun' mobile game was just a facade, it's fun for alittle bit

This is the worst game I've ever played. You pay money and you win, yes it is that easy I've been playing this game for over 3 years Even now, I'm encountering three level 16 opponents, even though I don't have a single one and the highest level I have is level 15, and I only have one. Is that because I didn't pay money Im very disappointed. Looking back, I should have spent my time on something else Stop saying it depends on skill, it depends on level.(trophy 9000) yes i'm playing over 3 years

I have mixed feelings about this game. The concept of this game is incredible, two sides fight against each other, trying their hardest to take the opponent's towers with troops and spells. But, supercell has ruined this concept. With the addition of level 16, the game has become into a "who has more money" rather than "who has more knowledge and skill" You can pay money to get anything. It's insane how incompetent and greedy a company can be to ruin a great concept of a game. 2 star.

I know the game advertised strategy but there isn't an ounce unless you spend a ton of money. progression is painful and slow and I've been playing for 2 years now and I'm still struggling because of the amount of whales there are in this game. it's all luck are you gonna verse someone with the same levels as you or are you gonna to go against a whale who has the next busted hero. plus they never listen to the community anymore. this game used to be perfect but greed killed it. no lvl 16 pls.

They need to stop releasing new game modes; league and trophies are fine But Merge Tactics, which gave it the same duration as League, makes it impossible to climb in both. Most of us definitely prefer League. And now the wars are so boring, they don't make you want to play. When it was a chest that filled up with crowns, you could play any mode and already contribute to war, that was the best. Honestly, they've just been ruining the game.

Coming from CX analytics, I find its major issue is whenever I go to the Royal Pass section to collect my rewards. If there are multiple rewards and I redeem one, I am supposed to land on the next reward to redeem it. Instead, I land on reward 1. Imagine if I need to redeem rewards from 16 or 26 and the number of unclaimed rewards is 13-15; it's frustrating to scroll down after every redeem.

Free to play 9 years. Upper ladder, though usually just play classic 1v1. It's a long grind to catch up to pay to win players with the various updates over the years to give players something do. You'll Win ten in a row, think you're a Champ, lose the next ten. Hero's are getting a bit rediculous of late, almost anautomatic win condition to get you spending. Don't give 'Em a cent.

Money grabbing pay to win game! Takes forever to farm stuff, just to end up getting cards you already have maxed out and are completely useless. The fact that you get random stuff from the loot boxes is already annoying to begin with, but not even getting things you can use is ridiculous.
