The chest take too long to open and sometimes it gets too hard to find a legendary card. Would definitely recommend. (Also I rate it 4.5 stars not 4!)

Clash royale is a fun, tower defense like game. You do not have to spend money to win in this game. I was able to obtain legendaries, cards, and push trophies without spending much money. Although I did spend 15$ on the game it was optional and didnt help the actual gameplay. I am now level 10 with every card in the game and am at Master 1. This game either requires lots of skill, or lots of money.

I've had my "good job supercell, this will be a hit" review up since the game came out. I'm taking my 5 stars to 2 stars. The new bugs are killing me. I just lost a game because of the reconnecting error it throws up every second game. You guys made a hit but it's taking a downfall. I hope you guys put in the effort to fix these bugs.

The game is fun to play both alone and with friends. Strategy and skill (prediction and timing) are on the same level, and that's why the game is competitive. Each game lasts max 6 minutes and that makes it so easy to just play one game and then stop if you are busy. The only (huge) cons is that either you pay with real money or you have to dedicate your entire life, for months, in order to get to a decent (competitive) level. I would give it 5 stars but this thing makes it 3 for me

Worst balance I've seen! The tournament fight is a really interesting idea, but I've never seen such an unfair gameplay! I'm lvl 9 and I usually don't pay for mobile games and I'm playing against lvl 10 players, who have nearly every card you could imagine. I couldnt even attack a single tower and lost 4 times in a row! So, if you want to play a game truly unfair, this is the right for you!

The game became very pay-to-win now. They released another update where they effectively reduced all of your cards' levels by one, and then push "deals" to you to make you buy with real money, so you can get back to your old level. You basically have to spend like 20 bucks to buy their battle pass monthly to be on equal footing with other ppl. If you didn't buy it, you would just lose to someone that did buy it. If you're not already invested in the game, I don't recommend to start playing it.

The game itself is good. But the amount of cards is simply unbearable. Too many cards, too many quirks that's not even workable and hard to understand, even by veterans of this game. The synergy between cards is inexistent. It was better when it has less than 100 cards with basic ability that can be synergized with other cards. It was great to play this game. I doesn't have the willingness to play anymore.

The concept is good, but the game itself is terrible. For starters it is one of the most unbalanced games out there. One day a certain card is broken and the other it is useless. (Although there are some cards that are consistently annoying like elite barbarians and mega knight). Secondly, it is pay to win. People willing to spend money are going to get a big advantage (it's worth noting that no content is kept behind pay walls). It only gets props for the creative game modes and the rare fun.

Not having a simple report system is frustrating. So many ways to make things harder or even boring for others and the game does not seem to focus on these issues. Every time you play a 2 vs 2 match, someone is going to troll you out. Whether it is in your team, or the other one. It always happens this way. Well, I once stopped playing. Now I'm doing it again. Thanks for the time spent =)

Cash grab updates, devs aren't listening and it's all about the money at this point. You get bombarded with ingame purchase offers, the gameplay is stale, it lacks innovation - the introduction of lvl 15 was the last straw, I think that the game is dying unless Supercell reverts the damage, that they've done. But currently I have no reason to believe that they will do so, they're too stubborn about it and will run the game into the ground. What a shame, it used to be an enjoyable game.

The game play is fundamentally great. So simple to understand yet so many layers of interactions, timing and transactions makes the game play very fun and makes you feel very skillful. However, progression is a slog (it took me 2 years to get to max), updates are very infrequent and underwhelming at best and there really is only 1 way of playing the game. I deleted my supercell account along with 4 years of experience and its been awesome.

The game at first was great. I have played it for 6 years. Until the continuous updates, unnecessary characters and excessive cash payments. Once you don't have money for a card upgrade , you will LOSE a Battle and trophies. Another issue the game has is this buggy feature during Clan Wars. You attack an enemy boat and their health bar for the cannons are still intact. Overall, the game used to be great, but NEWER ISN'T ALWAYS BETTER.

This game is really great. I've been playing since the game game out. Back when clans costed gems to make and when Legendary cards weren't a thing. I'm running a successful clan that wins wars almost every time and I am passionate about this game. However, the recent update as majorly impacted the experience of playing Clash royale. A lot of people I know can not access Clash aroyale anymore and every time I go to initiate a battle, the loading screen takes about 15 seconds which is drastically impacting my gameplay as enemies are taking out my towers before I even actually enter the game. Another issue that is really intoxicating for everyone is the new trading system. A lot of people are complaining stating that its "a MonEY GraB" and so on. My clan is filled with over 30 trade requests because trades have become so complicated and poor now. This was a really good game but I am afraid it will plummet into failure if you do not reverse the changes or recreate them in a way that suits everyone. If you read this, thank you for your time. This is a really good game but has had a devestating update.

Very pay to win, but it can still be kind of fun. Edit: It was 3 stars, but it's now so P2W that I can't progress at all. I'm not a bad player, I do decent in challenges. But I don't have the money to sink into all the evolutions. To be able to play multiple decks. Dagger duchess is what pushed me over the line. There are no more wild cards in the season shop, so unless you want to spend money enough, losing 1/2 the games because your tower troops are under levelled.

high reviews for this money grab game is either from those prepared to spend significant sums of money or those new to the game. Thought I'd update again after the introduction of the level 15 cards and evolution cards. Again as has been each update, it's just another money grab. They've boosted a set of cards that are impossibly difficult to upgrade unless you pay £5.99 each... These cards are boosted to such a degree you're pretty much going to lose if you don't have one and the opponent does!

Played for 8 years. They decided to make the game a fully pay to win game. Nearly no progress can be made if you were maxed level 14 when the evolutions came out. Been using the same deck for years, so has many people. Now everyone is forced to find a deck, hope that it stays relevant by the time you get the evolutions or level 15. Game used to be fun, challenging, easy to pick up at any point without feeling like you're playing a new game. Loved the game, until money became the main priority.

WORST UPDATE EVER!!!! I've played this game for about 4 years, was always a great time killer and was interesting. Since the last update, battle matches are unfair and the chances of winning a match are ridiculously low. It's made the game boring. I have pretty high level cards but I can't even fill my chest slots since the update. I've bought the battle passes each time, but I won't be spending any more money if things aren't fixed.... I'll be uninstalling instead, which is a massive shame 😔

EDIT - Game is still fun to play, is still dynamic, is still strategic. But the company has shown time and time again a disconnect from players. Clan war refactor was atrocious, and even if they took some steps to correct it, I still think it shows a stubbornness to stir back at unpopular changes, and the new upcoming addition of a new card/tower level that adds nothing other than just grind, and the dishonesty of announcing it after an event that nudged players at spending gold is a bad omen.

It is just a pay and play game. You can play for free for the initial level. But after certain level,you'll not get enough cards to level up untill you pay up. The match making also is very illogical. Also the server get disconnect a lot of time in between games. Especially when you play a limited entry matches. Pathetic.

I play very casually, usually coming back for a couple weeks every year before I stop again. I'm still disappointed by the lack of variety in the ranked game modes. Everyone is running the same/similar decks. This game has so much potential, but the lack of *REQUIRED* balance updates usually means running into the same types of decks against Enemies with the same play style. There's unfortunately no variety and as a result very little fun for casual free to play gamers.

I'm getting game lags and slow connectivity always when i open clash Royale which was not fixed still even after a year. It's not fun anymore. And another thing is that i often get low connection icon although my internet speed is super which often lead to loss. I'm starting to wonder if there's a crack game that messes with the actual game, to also note that it's happening over and over. I'm in love with the game but this right now is a heart break. I hope they really take care of their game.

Clash Royale is, and has alwaye been, a fun game to compete with other players or just pass time. I have played this game for 3 years now and I still find it fun. The main reasons I rated the game 4 stars rather than 5 are that at high levels progression becomes incredibly slow unless you pay. Obviously it makes sense that progression slows down, but in this case it is way worse than it should be. The other reason it lost a star is because the new matchmaking system is ridiculous.

It's become a pay-to-win game. I played it since it started and I really enjoyed it until the pass appeared. Now that I see a player using a different tower skin, I know this player will probably have better cards than me. I don't plan to spend money on a mobile game; I've done it before and I found it a total waste. Please try to match players according to their "paying status", so things are fair again.

Used to be one of the best mobile games, but for the past few years the game has become so pay-to-win, if not at the very least money-oriented, that even the whales have a hard time catching up. It's no longer about the cards or the gameplay, but on how much higher we can make the upgrade levels and costs to the point where any skill-based matchups get nullified. Anything that made the progression easier and simpler has now been removed or nerfed heavily. This game doesn't respect your time.

I've been playing this game for a while and the game has always been balanced for the most part... recently I've noticed a bit of a change and today I played a match on my new phone (so since I don't want to link my account to Facebook I started a new acct) where my opponent was 5 levels higher than me and all their cards were much higher. :-/ great game though, can't wait to see where you go with it.

Once I wasn't able to play 2 vs 2 because "I left many matches", the thing is that it was the game who left it, it crashed so many times, and still happening, that did not happen before, now I get very frustrated while playing because of many glitches and other things like balace between players, sad because i really liked the game but you had done few things to resolve this

This is why I will never invest in this game unless you're like them. This game is a cheat, when you figure out how to beat most of their line up, troop movement slows down and elixir generation slows down too then in the middle of the game, disconnects and re login you and you can never win any match when you see 'Reward limit reached'. And they clearly don't want anyone to reach 4000 trophies without any payments. Overall it's pay to win. What a great cheat game. In summary, MONEY TALKS..

As somone who's played this game since it came out, I have to say I'm very disappointed in what it's become. It was always a pay to win game, but it could be played with friends and you made it fun. Unfortunately the matchmaking still sucks. I wouldn't give it 2 stars for just that tho. I tried logging into my supercell id and it didn't let me. I want blocked and if I was, I should've been notified. I promise, when too update your game a lot of people will come back, just fix it, please!

After playing the game for over 3 years now I can not rate above 1 star... Game is all based on spending money in order to win (pay2win), the match system is unlikely to be fair, for example I myself am level 11 and fight against level 12 players etc.. This happens in order for players to pay for in game items of course. Overall I rate it with a single star because of the reasons mentioned above but also the lack of new updates that bring hype to the game.
the heroes have been balanced pretty well as well as new evolutions hero progression issues have been fixed

A game that keeps on giving. I've played this for years. I rate 4 stars, as I do think the game was better at first. Most updates and new cards seem to have changed the game to worse. Also every time a new card is made, it is over powered. I suppose this makes everyone want to own the card and spend money to level it up. Then after a year or so it is nerfed to balance. I love the game anyway!

It was all good about a year ago, but now every time i open clash royale , first match will be delayed upto 1 minute and i will be lost. It takes a lot of time to open every day's first match. I got my new bluetooth headphones and when i connect it, it is strucking with audio and more disturbances are coming. It is normal when i play without headphones. I thought it is headphones fault and i tried to listen songs on youtube without disconnecting them, it was excellent and same repeats again...

It's becoming more and more of a pay to win game. There's quite little you can do to progress, especially at the higher leagues, but then there are players who buy a royal pass and bam! They'd progress with the speed of light. There is an exponential difference in opportunities between those who pay and those who don't. It is now frustratingly difficult to keep on playing without paying. The only reason I gave it 2 instead of 1 star is that i' ve been playing this game from before it was p2w.

Match ups can be a little one sided. But a good simple to play game. ^^^ Initial review^^^ Since then ... Frustrated with constant "Balancing" of cards by the manufacturers ... The way I see it ... you focus on building the strengths of the cards you like to use based on a certain deck strategy ... then all of a sudden ... a card you have worked to build up gets a review (Witch😢) ... and no longer has the impact or works in with your strategy ... now trying to find a new strategy ...

Not gonna lie this is an amazing game. If you play it too long it may die out, like on me. But have to admit they have changed so much to the game but kept the core mechanics the same. Only thing is you need time to play the game or atleast pay to continue in some scenarios. Great game. Definitely recommend strategic players to try it out for yourself!!!

This game has one of the worst matchmaking system among other games. For real; I'm level 11 with my level 11 & 10 cards while my opponent is level 11 with their level 12, 13, & 14 cards. How am I supposed to defeat them? Although you could say it's a strategy game, but that's not the point. It's also an RPG game which has a level system. Whatever I do, my lvl 11 cards would never beat their lvl 13 cards. Sometimes I also face a level 10 player with their lower lvl cards, I feel bad for them too.

Honestly a very fun game, not too addictive and just as fun for casual gameplay as well as serious gameplay. Very simple to get the hang of and overall just a great game, i would probably rate the game itself 4-5 stars. However their suppory system is appalling. I have been trying for ages to find fixes for issues but seem unable to. The only 'help and support' they offer is a list of 50-100 questions, and if your question isn't on there, you're gonna have to solve it yourself. No live chats.

Played it very actively for over a year but then quit 4 years ago. I downloaded it again to check it out for a day, and was sad to note that the same issues plague this otherwise great game. There are a lot of new cards, but the common/rare ones are complete garbage. The best decks in the game still include 3+ specific legendaries, which are really hard to get if you're free to play. At least you get two or three guaranteed legendaries as you level up now but there's like 15 of them by now...

Done done and done with this game, I recently installed this again thinking I'd give it another shot. There is no change whatsoever.....in fact it's got worse. Such unfair gameplay. First of all the matchmaking is pathetic, it's pay to win. Unless you are willing to pay loads of money to buy the best characters you are not going to level up and you will lose every match (so frustrating 😡) The elixir is tampered with on certain matches. The fun has gone from it. FIX IT SUPERCELL!

Have been playing for more than 3 years, and this has been the final straw. Laggy servers, unexplained prices, and awfully pay 2 win. Prepared to get nothing but misery and years of getting tilted with them not giving anything for you. It has been one of the very best games I have played, but now has become the very worst I have seen. This had been a great journey, but as the hero lived long enough to become the villain, this game has become too much of a pain to play.

So annoying, i can't play it anymore. It used to be so much fun, but right now you enjoy it only if you spend money on a monthly base to buy things. Whenever i click that battle button i always get opponents 11 or 12 tower level with troops level 14. Like why is even possible? You get destroyed in a sec. Sure for a company the more profit the better, but there should be a balance because its becoming tiring for a big number of players.

Maybe the developers have given up on the game, but why can't they see the problem with a character when almost everyone has it in their deck. Firecrackers everywhere, all of the time. The game needs balanced. There's other favourites but you simply can't play a game without there constantly being a firecracker in play. She's too cheap and her damage is too strong. Oh, but let's make her evolve, that'll be a great idea 😆

Used to be one of my favorites, but I feel like it's slowly dying. Favorite content creators have slowly stopped creating content because it stopped getting views. Feels like the company just wants cash grab after cash grab. Used to have a good sense of progression with the monthly pass, but now the value of passes and shop deals have gone down drastically. The game is free to play, but if you are you will start progressing real slow after the first few arenas. I really hope it gets better.

Imagine an uno player try this game, and well that player is me. The game is a great time passer game the matches mostly take about 1-3 mins of gameplay. I just wish that they added a feature where I can save my gameplays to my device saying that I'm a content creator of many games already and I wanted to edit it. But still, its a great game until you reach a point where you'll feel stuck, keep pushing and you'll reach to the last arena. Goodluck on playing and I hope you reach your goal.

Save your money. The game is very unfair. It makes you play with higher level players all the time. I think it is all about money. The more you pay the easier matches you get. Level 8 players against level 10 and 11 players mathematically very difficult. Not fun for new players who are just growing. Clan wars require you to have 4 decks of 8 troops, which is 32. It won't be easy to level them all up easily and you will face a lot of unfair matches and unnecessary stress in your life.

Still playing it hoping the bot issue will be corrected . Seems the game will let u win 3 in a row, then take u down , over and over till u drop 1 or 2 arenas, This game would be great, if not for the 3rd party interference from bots, it allows them to cream u in minutes , they can toss out tons of high level troops that u cannot do, we an only work with 10 elixer drops at a time . So very frustrating, and if not fixed soon the game is gone, been playing from day 1, and the fun is getting ruined

Decent game, if you have never played this game before its OK at first and I do like the card feature. However, after a while it gets very repetitive, the war system isn't great and the chests are way to expensive considering you might not even get a legendry. The wait to open a chest is wayyyyyyy too long, like I said it's OK at first but overall its very repetitive and you don't get that sense of achievement after moving up a arena.

I have been playing this game for 6 years. Since the early and good days of it. The game was fun, challenging, and most importantly fair. However, through the recent years, it's like the game devs ate shifting more toward "pay to win", and it was at this point which marked the beginning of a downfall of the game. Imagine you have been playing the game for years, with so much experience and decent amount of resources, just to be beaten by someone who bought their way and maxed out everything.

Once I heard, good things always ends. I must say it is true. This game changes a lot of things, not in a good way. First they added more levels and champions, now they added much more money-hungry features such as evolution cards and diamond battle pass. They also removed books of books from the battle pass which is one of the valuest thing to buy from it. I feel like I can't continue playing this game any longer to save my money and sanity.

Warning: recent changes have ruined the game, it is completely different to previous years. It's very sad to see one of the best games from the 2010s, of any genre, be tainted by corporate greed - to such an extent that it is now not only Pay To Win, but Pay To Play. Supercell have been monetising the game to within an inch of its life, with the introduction of Level 15, plus card evolutions - you now can't even compete in higher sections of the main game mode unless you spend a lot of money

I played this for years, spent a lot of money and loved it, then for whatever reason they got rid of the best way to play, non trophy game modes were insanely fun, 2x elixir, 3x elixir, and everything in between, made it so much more fun then the standard mode and was optional for anyone who didn't want to play it. Gone. And so am I. Unistalled

unfortunately there's more and more cheats in the game, the match making has become ridiculous playing against people who are tiers above with maxed decks and sometimes seemingly with extra cards, supercell don't seem to care as long as people spend lots of money. Sadly the game is becoming unpleasantly unplayable

I've been playing this game for 7 years now and the latest changes to the game are just greedy. They have increased the cost of the premium by 25% and decreased the bonuses you get for it, and then to add insult, they now have en even more expensive tier for double what it used to cost, only to get what you used to get for half the price. You are selling virtual items with zero expense. You are officially ripping off your customers. I will never give Supercell money again. This is too far.

I've been playing this game for fer years, it was a great game, very well balanced and I had a lot of fun playing. Up to now, with all the new paid buffs, it is simply impossible to play without paying, in freemium game model to destroy the balance in such a way is suicide! Good luck with keeping you player audience with a 5% win rate for non paying player. It really sucks you destroyed the game. Goodbye.

It was good when it launched. Now its just pay to win. I am always matched against a higher level player once i cross a certain threshold in trophies so basically I'm stuck at one place. I have to wait like this for long time or i can buy ton of gems and level up my cards fast. The developers getting greedy day by day. They are more focused on cosmetics and less on mechanics & matchmaking, so this is a pay to win basically.

Great game, occasionally you'll come across people who pay to play but you dont have to spend money to enjoy 2021: I have been playing this game off/on for the last 4 years and sadly it has become saturated with loot boxes & pay to play mechanisms. The last 4 years is proof that there is an algorithm which prevents you from collecting and maxing the cards you most use, without spending money. It's akin to gambling, it really sucks that a lot of kids play this and are used to pay to win games.

Played this game on and off for years. Makes the game difficult when some players use "cheats". Have played against some where the creatures made are impossible to make as quickly as they have. And when watching the battle back, the opponents elixir bar fills suspiciously fast. No way you can make a mega knight, pecka, with support before they cross to your side of the field.

I'm sorry to say that this game is no longer brilliant. It is definitely aimed at pay to win players. The December update has made it impossible to upgrade cards by trading because both players need a trade token and who'd waste one of those on a trade they didn't particularly want. Also higher players tend not to donate cards anymore as they have to pay to do so once they're max level. Terrible. Fix this. This was my 5 star review:"I download a lot of games but end up uninstalling them as I get bored. I have played this everyday for almost a year and have not been bored the entire time. You can play as much or as little as you like and works well whether you want a free to play game or a pay to win game. Brilliant."

I have been playing this game for many years (at least since 2018/2019, if not earlier. I used to LOVE this game, I made friends and family download it so we could play together, and it was a blast! I had great times and really enjoyed farming my way up. Since the introduction of the "double battle pass" and evolutions, I think they've been pushing a bit too much into the hard currency rewards/pay to advance mechanics, but what I personally find worse of all is the endless scrolling in the UI

This game is great it runs on most devices with no lag (maybe internet lag but nothing they can do to fix that) and has action packed matches what last up to 5 mins. You can play the game without spending anything but the game tempts you into it. I have spent maybe £10 on it and I'm at a pretty high trophy count missing only 2 cards. One problem is smurfs. Every 3-5 games you will encounter someone 3 levels above you and there is nothing you can do. Anyway great game would recommend!

Just another pay2win game You can play normally at certain point with basic cards, but after a time, you'll get opponents with higher level towers and cards than yours, that its almost impossible to win, not only the matchmaking gets horrible, the chances to get good card are extremely rare, and once you get you're stuck in the same level for a long time, if you want to have fun for a time and delete go for it, but if not you'll be forced to spend money to keep going up.

Great game, fun and somehow strategic. However, the "pay to win" royale pass is unfair for players who did not purchase the pass. One might play for a year and work their way to a level 12, while a player with the pass could reach higher levels in 6 months. The best solution is to match players according to their status, that is, if they have paid for credits or not.

So this is how the algorithm works now - you win 2-3 games at a stretch and then start loosing. After loosing some matches you win one or two and again start loosing. In the sometimes they'll give you a huge trophy push, and then bring you down so that you are hooked to gaining back the lost trophies. This makes the game addictive in a frustration way. I used to play this before, then stopped, again started. But from now I'll never play this anymore. Also it's so pay to win now.

it was fun!!! but once they made the game more about spending money it become so annoying. this game is made in such way that u will not enjoy it if you don't spent money. 4 years ago it was the best mobile game and now it just feels like they don't care much about fairness. I was tower level 12 with all my troops are either level 12 or 13. I faced player that had tower level 11 but units that were maxed out. it shouldn't be that way. if u want to download it make sure you have money to spent.

The unlock times are so freaking long. Don't get me wrong, the gameplay is very good, but damn it puts a damper on things. Yeah, you can play even if the chest queue is full but dn, it feels so unrewarding if you do since you don't get anything... I understand that you need to timegate stuff supercell, but the way you went about it is... Pretty poorly thought of to say it nicely.

I have been playing this game for the last 8 years and now this has become the worst game I have ever played. Every time I got disconnected during battle and because of this I lost 2000+ trophies. I need compensation.

Matchmaking rigged for you to lose to make you buy gems. Endless microtransactions. Just a few of the problems with this mobile version of an EA game. When this was released a couple years back, it was absolutely amazing and supercell made a masterpiece. Now, all they care about is money. Making a battle pass that gives huge competitive advantage to those who buy it. Matchmaking that puts me up against level 10s and every now and then 11s when I'm level 9 with higher level cards. Ridiculous.

It's a pay to win game, don't recommend it. It may seem that you can upgrade without spending real money, but the algorythms of the game are way more clever than you think you are. So it will force you to spend real money, to achieve what other p2w players has achieved. It will only give you opponents that are higher level than you. It's not strategy, it's unbalance and p2w game. It's not a hate, I've been playing this game for more than two years, and I only have two cards upgraded at max lvl))

I played the game for almost 2 years. Even spent some money, which is rare for me. But these last two updates back to back have really shown that supercell is no longer concerned with keeping things fair or a lesser version of pay2win. If you like spending money to have a significant advantage, this game is for you. It'll be a fun game until you reach the higher end of the game. Then be prepared to break out your wallet to get ahead in any way. Game is a joke now.

You should be able to change your name as many times. But either than that it is a good game. I change my mind. I have been playing this gane since the dawn of time and the state it's currently in is just sad. They chase nothing but profit by forcing you to play against people who are in higher levels than you so that you are enticed to buy in-game purchases. The season resets are also a way to make you pair with higher level players. Game is not fun and I would not reccomend downloading it!!!!

Absolutely scam. Biggest money making game I've ever played. Not about the experience of the players.. Bring out updates and make the game harder, trying to make people who play it spend more. Probably bots too. Also bring out an update where the maximum characters have to get further levelled up. Sick of it. Also, not to mention you can't buy what you want; everything is wild-carded making it an EVEN more of a money making scheme. Go away

For a real time strategy game you'd expect a more balanced troop levelling 
system. The end game drop off means without spending a dime, it'll take you 
at least a year for you to get legendaries to level 3 and epics to level 7. 
However, due to the nature of this game, it is extremely tempting for 
people to pay for diamonds, pay for chests (which still not guaranteed a 
legendary card). I do not recommend this game to anyone since you will end 
up wasting your money for no reward.

One word can be used to describe this game, pay 2 win. Game starts of enjoyable than you reach a point where every match you go against cards 4 levels higher than yours, this makes it almost impossible to win unless your opponent is completely incapable. Progression is very slow, the only way to progress faster is by paying. So I would not recommend this game, every once in a while you get a glimpse of hope to keep you going. But you are destined to fail without a credit card.

This game has been deteriorating for a few years now, but the latest upgrade has decimated the game. The structure of the game has been made 'brainless'. Up until recently you had a few options to build cards in a minor way via the 'shop'. Now there is no way to play things you're own way. After playing this game for 9 years, this latest update has destroyed the game. I think Supercell realizes the game is fading and they are out to get the last of the Pay to win players before it folds.

Clash Royale could've been one of the best mobile games. The gameplay is fun, fast-paced, and strategic. But it's heavily pay-to-win, ruining the experience for casual or fair players. Early on, progress feels good—you unlock cards and improve. But soon, you face players with over-leveled decks unless you pay a lot. It's frustrating and unfair. Not recommended if you're free-to-play. And bring back the season shop for us the free-to-play

The game is great, I play it as often as I have breaks...which is a lot! However, since the recent update, I have notice that some of my cards have been 'replaced or better yet...removed. Almost lime some of my progress has been removed. Cards I had, I no longer have. Please fix. Over a year now, and still waiting for some sort of reply/response from the developers. It's clear they are working on the game, as there are updates. But at the same time, clear they read the comment. Typical.

Fallen from grace. This still is one of the best mobile real-time-strategy games but I just cannot recommend it after all the predatory changes to the monetization system. You will like it at first but eventually the gameplay becomes unfun as you must bang your head against the wall that is max level decks which you will never be able to obtain.

Similar to the other reviews I've seen, I've had this game pretty much since release and it has become noticeable how pay to win the game has become. You can reach the higher rankings simply by spending money when it used to take skill and strategy. Still a fun game, but not something to get too invested in if like me you don't wish to spend money.

Been playing for more than 3years. They make it easy for you to play at the start, but makes it almost Impossible to win unless you pay for upgrades later on. In the end, strategy doesn't matter since you will be matched with level13/14 paying players who haven't even played a long time. At least in PUBG upgrades are cosmetic and doesn't affect your game performance. This game is all about making money. Don't waste your time. Oh this causes Screen Burn in over time.

It's definitely the worst game of Supercell nowadays. Each update they are monetizing everything in the game. Battle pass, Golden Bank and, especially, the "best" offers in the shop. Balance of the game became pay to win battles where you will be stuck for a long time before you upgrade to a level on which you will be able to make some progress on your path. I was playing this game from the release of it, feeling bad about these changes to my favorite game then.

I have spent untold thousands of hours on this game. The core gameplay is the best game ever made. However, the last few updates have been shifting the game towards more and monetization. Games need to make money, but it shouldn't lock away gameplay. There is so much potential for more cosmetics. Charge through the roof for skins, for customising your side of the arena etc. I would pay so much to get a limited edition brand deal starwars lightsaber for a mini pekka, or whatever. Not level 15!

It's a good game but hard to be a casual player. If you want to play for free, there comes a point where you can't hope to compete because your cards are too underpowered. Spending real money to upgrade your cards is a waste of time for the average player because you're looking at literally thousands of pounds to max out your account, at which point you're up against the big boys, and essentially in the same boat as when your cards were underpowered, except you've blown all your cash.

after playing on and off for a significant amount of time I've decided how I feel about this game, its fun but its flawed to the point where even casual play becomes a chore. The game is pay to win at its core, to win games you need to level your cards, cards are leveled using gold and extra cards, cards can be bought using gold, gold can be bought using gems and gems are bought using real money. it quickly becomes unenjoyable as you wont progress very quickly without paying.

Working as a software tester led me to realise that no program could ever be perfect. However, there are some glaring issues to this game, especially with the new update. 1. When doing clan war battles, if you get 2 or more victories (aka at least 1 tank broken), you should get 3 lucky drops. However, this is not the case. 2. The push back on how rewards are obtained in favor of some money is a kill-joy in my opinion, especially with no more in-game currency shop. Shadow what the game was tbh

When I started playing it was a perfect, simple game, now it's way overcomplicated and completely pay to win, it has left me no choice but to either pay or uninstall. The update that brought evolutions is pretty sick, but they are way too overpowered, and anyone can just pay to get them, while they could be free, so everyone is even. Such a twisted way of making money, hope you learn from your mistakes.

Im really fed up of the way supercell are making the game pay to win again. It was at a point where as pay to skip it was acceptable, but as I got to the upper leagues and they add another level? The people that can afford to spend stupid amounts on this will beat me with higher level cards, though they wouldn't beat me with same level. You should only ever pay for aesthetics in games like this. Feel ripped off. I have played as long as CR has been around and spent more than I could afford.

This used to be a 5 star game. The update to level 15 and card evolutions makes the gap between high spenders and no/low spenders so great that there's not really any point playing unless you're going to full on whale. I've given it a few months, thinking "maybe it'll get better and I'll get used to it" but there's no getting around it, a player with level 14 cards is simply outpowered by a player who spends and has a bunch of evolved level 15 cards.

The game is really fun, addictive, and well-made. But sometimes it feels like you need to spend money to progress faster — especially when facing opponents who boosted their cards with purchases. That doesn’t feel fair. In the end, this game is either about patience and smart strategy, or paying to progress quickly.

I have been in here for a long while and I have spent some money as well. The game presentation is a hoax, along with the game itself. There exists no balance whatsoever, as supercell would have you believe, there are not even basic restrictions and rules, in order to make sure that the game is having a basic concept, it is an anarchic mumble jumble, sold as something else.

Let me completely honest. this game has fallen off so much it's unreal, it seems supercell is trying it's best to ruin this game for anyone who doesn't spend money on microtransactions. it's like call of duty all over again but on mobile. it is pathetic and scummy, it used to be bearable, you used to have so much things that would help you level up your cards as a free to play, I have been playing this game for around 4 years now- I recently unistalled it because the changes were too much.

This game's goal is not to entertain you, but to make you buy at least something. The internal store is not an option, it is a prerequisite. A very large number of players with legendary cards and cards that you can only get through three or four arenas. Only a cyber-athlete who created a new account for fun will be able to play comfortably and grow at low levels.

This game used to be fun, but now it's a money-making scheme. They sell you on it being a free to play game, but the gap between a free to play player and someone who pays for perks like season passes is miles. Besides all that, I recently got scammed by them. It claimed that I made shop purchases that I didn't. When I went to inquire in the help section, they lied to me multiple times and tried to make it seem as though it was my problem even though I had proof it wasn't. I'm sick of this. 😔

i have been playing this game since its launch... about 9 years ago. Was one of my favourite games. However over the last few years the game became so much pay to win is incredible. You cannot compete without spending as you cant keep up with the new cards and new evolutions. Also it is so obvious that once you start winning the game gives you the worst matchups in order to go down again. Its a never ending cycle. I just deteleted it and i strongly advise to stay away from this game.

With each update they make the game worse and worse. It is anti consumer and anti free to play, as to have any meaningful progression you need to spend money. This is already annoying enough, but add to that the fact that the pricing is horrendous, and you get a terrible progression system. The base game is fun enough one you get to max level, but of course to do that you must spend money, and all of the other game modes they add aren't fun, they are very basic. Do not recommend

The game at lower levels is luring and habit forming. At higher levels, no matter how many chests you open, the algorithm will not let you upgrade any card to level 10 or above at least not the cards that matter unless you purchase something from the clash royale shop. It draws unbalanced game for you to finally make a purchase for good cards. Fraudulent by design. They think people won't understand their trickery.

Recently I've seen many negative reviews, and to make sure you can see both sides of the coin I am sharing my opinion. This is one of the best games for mobiles. It's has ton of different well thought mechanics, nice style, catching gameplay (like for sure, I'm playing for 5 years) it's made good, it is the original. People complain about card upgrading, they say it's too long, and you can speed up this process with purchases, you can, but it doesn't affect gameplay, only your skill will, enjoy

Greedy. The only thing the developers have in mind is fattening their own pockets. The recent balance changes and taking away the season shop while also implementing this new ranked system made the game (somehow) even more pay to win. They finally made the game utterly and completely unplayable. Congratulations! It's a fun game nonetheless and there's no other like it but I won't be playing it, unless something changes.

Clash Royale is a very fun (and addictive) game. It is a extremely exciting mobile game, that forces you to stay calm under pressure. It is a fantastic game overall, except that it's pay-to-win. It's SUCH a big frustration, because, unlike a lot of other games, you don't pay for cosmetics. You actually pay for the most overleveled stuff. I don't pay a cent, and it is really hard to keep up with all the overleveled/pay2win players out there.

Be warned. This game heavily involves either countering or being countered by the enemy. Rarely does this game involve a proper fair 1v1 scenario. I have played this game for over a year now and the only reason i am still playing is because of the time i have invested into it. I do not recommend spending money onto this game since most of the deals are just overpriced. However, I do enjoy the variety of different characters that are available to choose from aswell as the war day gamemode.

The concept of the game is fun, yes, the execution is terrible. What used to be a fun game has, in the past few years, turned into a terrible pay to win game. Supercell, being the greedy company they are, of course make it so that if you're a free to play player, the progression takes years, and after a certain point is just plainly impossible without the need to spend money. They're removing free ways to progress, and making it so you have to pay. And they don't nerf OP pay to win cards.

Update - now it's even more obvious that paying players are given the advantage. Meeting same or lower level opponents with higher level cards all the time. Additionally, strange things are happening to save opponents when they are losing. Google should take this game out of the store and review what is going on, fewls like a complete scam now. Pay to win. If you don't pay you will not get ANY good cards. The paying players have an edge that is impossible to handle if you don't pay.

Every update makes the game worse. What used to be a game of strategy has become a game with no skill due to the inclusion of evolutions. Furthermore, every update makes progression more difficult unless you spend a large amount of money. Do not download this app. They do not care about the player experience only about money. And as with my experience, it has only gotten less fun throughout the years and is now unplayable.

Game was a lot of fun for years. Then came tencent. Since they purchased Supercell, it's been downhill fast. This latest champions update with level 14 was the last straw for me. Just another in a long series of attempts to get their greedy fingers on my wallet. Playing War Alliance now. It's actually fun. Thanks for ruining a once great game.

Clash Royale used to be one of my favorite games. The strategy provided interesting gameplay, the progression was fun, and you felt accomplished. However, as of late, it seems that the dev team is making the WORST possible choice with every update. Evolutions were broken for almost their entire lifetime and continue to be troublesome, limited modes and challenges are less fun, clan war is uninteresting, and now progression has been MURDERED. I don't understand why these things had to happen.

Latest update is broken and hangs on startup while showing "Account alert" dialog. The review below is for older version of this game. Probably the best game created by Supercell. I think it's not worth using real money because early stages are the best part of the game and that's the part that you can skip with little real world money. The resources you get in the game grow linearly but the prices go up exponentially. Expect to pay hundreds of dollars if you want top cards with shortcuts...

I used to play this game 7 years ago and came back because of nostalgia. It has changed a lot, mostly for the worse. The cards now are more unbalanced than ever, which killed deck diversity. In the trophy mode, the game punishes you for winning, as you end up with fewer and underleveled cards against stronger opponents. Unless you are planning to play with friends, I don't recommend.

Been playing this game in 2017, I have some issues and problems, problem 1: matchmaking, sometimes I get paired with the player 2 levels over me or even under me. (to be completely fair) problem 2: You literally need to play this game every single day to gain a lot of experience which takes forever to level up when your level 7-8 and higher. Problem 3: Its pretty pay to win. If you ran out of money, you will either pay with gems or real money which grinding players find it annoying. That's all.

This game is well ,how should I say this without being rude ,not in its best ,but it is worthy a try. I mean ,it could be better but I still like spending my free time trying to beat other players. It has its problems though ,like for example , you are a low level player and when you decide to play duel , you play with a very strategic player in which is nothing compared to you or its lags that may bug your experience in the game , despite all those issues , I will give this game three stars. ★★★

This game was perfect when It released. But now, It just pay to win and some troops need to be fixed (Huge damage, bad movement, and some players copy paste each other when the game should be depends on skills. The only thing they focused on is the shop lol. It's really boring to play it these days. And btw, I'm a high level player so don't think I wrote this review because I'm bad or anything else. I just want to share my opinion on a game which I missed its old version.

Recently, came back to game. Found it impossible to make your way up trophy road. The amount of bots they have programmed into the game to fill games quickly is insane. Every second game you vs a bot, check their stats, generic names, pictures and they have thousands of wins. The bots have perfect counters to everything you put down and is virtually impossible to progress. They are killing their game in search of making money, tricking people into spending real money to get better cards.

The game used to be good: You get chests, up your card levels, enjoy and that's it. Now it has SO MANY things you need to pay LOADS of money to be able to level up properly and "enjoy" the game for five minutes. It's just a cash grab at this point. Now it's not about who has better strategy, it's about who has more money into their accounts. Absolutely ridiculous. If you want to burn some cash, this game is what you're looking for.

I was playing since 2021, and a lots have changed till now. I can say that most of it wasn't to shabby, but it always created that constant feeling of the game just being more and more expensive. Recently, I have lost all of my magic books because of the update without warning, it chose random cards to fill, I had so much plans for these books, I even had a book of books, and you take it away to introduce something even worse? HEROES+LVL16?? You aren't even hiding it anymore, you steal our money

I had a good review up for years, but this game is now a shadow of what it once was. last few updates murdered progression, rewards, and even the audio is now butchered. This newest update has changed/destroyed the foundation of a nearly 10 year old game, and the few remaining non-pay-to-win aspects are completely gone. thanks for that. and also thanks for automatically opening the 8 year old chest I had saved since Arena 4. this game is unplayable.

I used to think this game was great, but honestly by this point it's the worst money grab I've ever seen on Google Play store. They make you think you're strong, then the matchmaking throws you against near impossible opponents, making you feel the need to spend money in order to keep playing and progressing. And when you do, the matchmaking somehow gets worse and you don't see any progression. Every new update ruins something people loved and limits the game more, forcing unwanted purchases.

this game is basically unplayable for people who don't spend anything on it. if you don't buy the battle pass, which is horrendously overpriced, you don't stand a chance of climbing at all. rng favours those who put money into the game. you will always be in a bad matchup with under leveled cards if you don't pay. Supercell should really offer refunds on the gold that is spend on a card when they rework it. All of the time and gold has now gone to waste. No point in playing this game at all now

The devs are seriously killing this game by not listening to the community & making the game a disgustingly money grabbing situation where you need to spend lots and lots of money to be able to compete in a fair way. It's a shame becuase it has so much potential but the game is just running into a thick wall. And let me be more clear, level 15 simply sucks & we do not need it!

This game used to be really fun, I had a blast around 2021 - 2022. But, recently... with all the Broken Evo's and Broken Hero's, Free to play players just can't keep up. (They are attempting to make the game better so you can get cards you want with gems... but it just isn't enough.) If you wanna play for free, I'd recommend any other game, as you'll just get annoyed. But if you like spending money... go ahead.

Used to be a fun strategy game, but now it’s just a cash grab. The developers clearly imbalance the game on purpose to push players into spending money. Progress is ridiculously slow unless you pay, and new overpowered cards are introduced just to milk the paying players. If you're not spending, well, good luck... It’s gone from skill-based to wallet-based. Disappointing.

At first I thought this game is gonna be at least alright in terms of strategy but it turns out that if you don't have the card, no matter what strategy you use, you are destined to loose the game. Specific cards like Baby Dragon, Skeleton Army, and etc are cards that will give you a really high advantage which in turn guarantees your opponent's loss. Also, the card selection just sucks. You can't view a card's abilities just because you don't have it or not in the level to have it? What??

Player and spender of more than 8 years and now is finally the time to completely cancel this game. It started with legendary characters and they have done it again with the champions. We accepted all this,but level 15 ?! Ridiculous decision by dev ops. They could have pivoted and made money through so many other ways but they have given up and are now resorting to take in as much money as possible to the point where they are okay if it kills the game. Capitalism 1 Gaming community 0

Prior to wars 2.0, I had given this game a rating of 5 stars. The old style of wars required building a level capped deck from a limited pool of cards and required real skill to build well and because of the level cap, all players were on a level playing field. You were required to play 1.5 matches per day with opt out. All of that said enter wars 2.0 where you can't opt out, there isn't a level cap, and you are required to play 4 matches per round. Clan died from this update.

Just came back to the game after 3 years, and it's a pure nightmare, if you're planning to come back and give this game another go, please don't for the sake of your own sanity. The constant pay-to-win forcing, and locking broken units behind pay walls is really saddening, considering how good the game originally was. It has gone to shambles and is down in the dirt right now.

I've been playing since the beginning, 100% f2p. I'm at lvl 13, I've got 13 maxed cards right now. I'm missing some sort of goal. I'm slowly maxing card after card, even legendaries, through requesting. Playing the game does not really further this, there are hardly any rewards I want which could make me push trophies. I'm just logging in three times a day to do the routine and that's it.

For someone who played this game since its beta stage back in 2016, it's saddening for me to write this review. The stark difference between this and Clash of Clans, is how terribly greedy the pricing strategy of this game has become. Two kinds of season pass subscriptions and overpriced cosmetics. You even got that piggybank nonsense crammed into the game. So many unnecessary updates as well. I remember back then when the game didn't even reach 100 MBs in size. Now it's almost half a gig.

I play this game every day and I've made good progress without spending a penny. I'm on Level 11 with nearly 13,000 points. However, the game is plagued with connection issues. I can guarantee to lose the first game of every day because the app takes so long to connect to the server. By the time I'm into a game, it's practically over. Subsequent games connect perfectly normally. Other than that problem, the game is well balanced and fun to play

It's a really fun game to be honest, but it's p2w, for example, evolutions. You can buy them from the shop but if you're f2p you have to wait 3 months to even get 1 Evo, and I get that everyone is p2w and they all have higher level cards. But skill is important too, but if there's a too significant level difference there's just no way to win, still kinda fun to come back to time to time but it's just so aggravating when you proceed to reach 1 game away from next arena you lose indefinitely.

After playing this game for almost 10 years, I'm finally deleting it. Once you reach a certain level and win a trophy, the game starts favoring your opponents in the next few levels. In the recent update, they even removed the chests, which is extremely frustrating. I'm no longer playing this game, and with these kinds of changes, more people will probably stop playing it too.

Played it for almost 7 years and I must say, they are trying really hard to get players into paying. It became pay2win and that's just sad because it really had potential. Since they published tower level 15, I'm being spammed with offers, where I can upgrade my card to level 15 for "only" 7,99€. On the other hand, if you don't pay, you really have to grind in the game to upgrade only one card to level 15, it's ridiculous. The evolutions are pay2win as well- either play for 6 months or pay 15€

The game is fun, and I can see myself playing it for a while especially whilst I'm travelling. However, there are server side issues that really need to be looked at. Although I have full bars and my connection is stable via data and WiFi, my games have a habit of losing connection, ruining the overall experience. I would say the game is definitely worth giving a shot, I just hope this issues gets dealt with soon.

Pretty good game, until arena 6 when it becomes pay to win. The game markets itself as a strategy game, but after a while it just becomes a matter of who has the highest card and king levels, which is directly controlled by how much money you pump into the game. Also there are the legendary cards which are really rare (easy to get if you pay a lot though) and some are really overpowered. Fun in the beginning, boring pay to win "game" after a few hours.

The issue is as many have mentioned that the beginning is very enjoyable up until you have spent enough time to be hooked at the game. At which point "matchmaking" only ever puts you against players that have a perfect counter deck, or are completely maxed out, in other words telling you "you can be that good too just buy them chests so you can get maxed out too" as getting chests the free to play way is incredibly slow. Conceptually I love the game, but supercell is worse than EA as a company.

So the game is amazing. Graphics are great cards nice and easy to drag around the field. But lately I have been having some problems. When I try to join the Modern Day Challenge or something like that the percentage goes up slowly and when it hits 100 it crashes and when I click on Clash Royale it crashes. So I have to restart the app every time I want to go back but still cannot join a game. Overall a very good app

I've played the game since day 1 and it was such a joy to play and everything was so awesome about it,but unfortunately now, everything has changed,the devs and the company has taken the joy from it,it's pay to win ,same cycle decks that's needed to win,no strat ,just cycle and win, idiotic heroes, evos and everything is behind a paywall, I'm sorry Supercell but I literally hate u guys for ruining something I used love with all my heart ,and I'll never ever forgive u guys for it.uve taken my joy
Fully pay to win Totally Biased Every time your enemy troops are 1 level higher than yours

this new update is terrible!! i have to rate it 1 star to show how far backward you have gone!!! its things like how can you get rid of the event shop, and just chuck more onto the season pass!?... effectively you've made it harder and we won't be able to get as much value out of our time!!! making it harder to upgrade and further progress into the game. I'm going to take a break from the game now and come back when hopefully they sort something about this, because this is a joke

An amazing game but would not recommend. At first the game feels amazing, but the more you progress the more you will be at a disadvantage if you are free2play. At a certain point it simply becomes necessary to spend money on the game to have any chance to even compete. I've been playing for over 2 years and I'm not even close to maxing out a single card and in my rank (Challenger 2) every other guy has his whole deck maxed. The game had great potential but has been ruined by corporate greed.

Overall the game is the best game. It easy to get into a game and you can trade cards with you clan mates. Sometimes I get a message saying that a chest is open and fifty present of the time it is ready to be opened. Also the most of the cards when you get up to when you get your first lengerdy card they start to cost 5-10 so you just can't spam them. In conclusion I think that it is a very good and fun game to play. Yes there are pros and cons and it is really fun to play

The overall mechanics of the game are fun, though sadly it has become nothing more than a cash grab in recent years. Shop offers becoming more and more expensive and offering poor value, new overpowered cards being released which can only realistically be obtained by spending money and progression being next to impossible without buying the aforementioned offers. The game being pay to win has become even more noticeable nowadays.

It wasn't as good as it was before. This game is losing its strategic game title, it's becoming a Pay to Win game. Most players have purchased Royale Pass, and other items that they could benefit from. They have an advantage over the other free players. And one more thing, there are players who had already acquired legendary cards you moved in greater arenas. You shouldn't have moved those cards. Or at least remove the cards of other players who acuired them before. I have hopes for u supercell.

This game is definitely awesome, however there's a bug I incountered and even I tried to clear the data of this app and kog in to my previous account, the bug was still there. The bug I incountered is there's a notification in my magic items that won't disappear. It is so disturbing to look at. And that's all, I hope you will be able to fix it.

This is a great game! The gameplay is great and doesn't get old, the graphics are simple yet great, and generally a great game. As much as I'd love to give this app a five star review, recently since the new update my game crashes on the loading screen. I get that things like this happen but I can't help but feel annoyed, as I am now going to be kicked from my clan for missing war. Anyways, great game, just please fix this issue.

I've been playing this game for over 6 years and honestly, I really liked it at first. Recently it has become boring for me. There are a lot of characters in the game in a short time. Therefore, it made some old characters ineffective and worthless and you cannot use them. Also, when you reach an advanced level, if you play in an offensive way, you will not go far in the game, unlike playing in a defensive and frustrating way. It's not the same as playing became frustrating

I am changing my 5⭐ to 1⭐. I loved this game and have been playing for over 6 years and recently the game is modified to do good only for people who spend money and buy the royal pass. The matchmaking has also become very unfair and not at all encouraging to play. They only give you hard encounters and it is such that every game you play is designed for you to lose. The gameplay has become very demotivating. Hope the developers read this

Gameplay is very good, but the game itself since a few updates is just 'pay to win'. Honestly your skill level doesn't matter anymore. You can straight up buy yourself huge advantages over other players using your money. And this is not something I will accept in a game that tries to be 'competitive'. I mean I want to compete with my skill, not with my wallet.

DON'T install it. The app crashes, there's lag, connection breakdowns, player matches way below and above our gamer's skills. Lately, you sometimes can't place your card onto the field which leads to a lost battle. Oh, not to mention when your opponent starts before you! Why am I still playing it? Because I've played for 3 years and I'll wait for a change.

Have been playing the game for a while. Initally I really liked the game and had fun with the clan I'm in. However since the release of the new clan wars, I've also lost interest in the game unfortunately. As the clan wars was one of my favorite things to do. I still like the game from time to time but then only for one game and then am done again. Quite sad to see the game going from 5 stars for me to 2..

Expect to have to pay if you don't want to be playing for 3 years to get a maxed deck. Once you're there, though, it is fun, I must admit. The party mode they recently added keeps gamemodes in cycle, which is nice. Ladder is surprisingly balanced currently, though war is getting stale. Overall a solid 4; it's the only game I've kept installed over new devices.

This game has become a mess. I've played since day one. It's better in some ways now than what it used to be. Progression is much easier so you can level up and get to the 'real' game. However, miss match galore. You will be destroyed repeatedly in quick succession. Clan wars are a pure mess now. Yes I may be level 13 but I'm using cards I don't use to make a 4th deck which is made of lvl 10 - 11 cards, where I am matched against a maxed level deck. No chance of winning. Pure waste of time.

Game was really good until they decided to implement the "season pass" It's obvious that if you do not buy it, you will never pass a certain level ! I've given this game 5 stars before, but now, I removed it and give it only 1 , and I do think it's too much. As someone else said, the giant has fallen... Sad but true. Is there a way to give 0 stars? Gold diggers... Don't pay and get frustrated. They will do whatever they can to take your money. Do not fall for this.

Used to be a 5 star game. Is now stale and dying. Format hasn't really changed in 6 years. Most updates have been superficial to say the least. Clan Wars is trash. Needs a complete revamp. Has become a source of frustration for me; stuck at the same trophy level on ladder for years. SC, please add more modes and give us something else to do. The game is just boring now.

I have 5 bases that I have bought the monthly pass for religiously for the last year, and with the new changes, I just wanted you guys to know, it will not happen again. Game was good before but now it's almost entirely pay to win, and matchmaking isn't fair at all, you will be placed against opponents twice your level and with cards that you can only get at that level by paying real money. After this update I'll mostly be on standby for this game. 6.99 was already high enough for a monthly pass... now it's 8.50 for a meh version, or 17 for the diamond pass... this game has become the definition of pay to play over a short period of time.. this more or less was the last game I religiously played as it was fun and not entiiiiiirely money grabbing. Awful game. It was great when there weren't so many tryharders. Unplayable, and the matchmaking is always against some players. Great game turned into P2W trash. I loved Clash Royale at the start, but as you progress through the game, which takes a long time, more time is needed to even have a chance against opponents. Two stars only because this game is great in all aspects except one, the matchmaking. Great game, play all the time with my friends and family, also best game to pass the time on a long-haul flights or long drive journeys or to play in your spare time It says their are ads but the only time there is if you want them.
